Sam's first day: texted at a coworker's suggestion. Sounded tired and unsure ("idk"), opening up slowly. Works nights as an ER nurse and picked getting fitter ("fitter maybe"). ZOH asked where and when they could work out, but Sam said they had to crash and would talk tomorrow.
pages.body: Sam's first day: texted at a coworker's suggestion. Sounded tired and unsure ("idk"), opening up slowly. Works nights as an ER nurse and picked getting fitter ("fitter maybe"). ZOH asked where and when they could work out, but Sam said they had to crash and would talk tomorrow.

pages.summary: Sam replied after waking at ~3pm, apologetic about sleeping through the morning text. Short, casual replies ("ya", "idk"), but warmed up a bit. Shared that they sleep 8 to 2 after shifts, said they used to run in college and want to run again, and named a park nearby. They said they track on Strava and, after a nudge for a clear answer, agreed ("yeah im in") to the plan.

pages.summary: Sam's first run day. Said "yep" to the plan, then ran in Forest Park and sent a Strava screenshot (1.10 mi, 14:02). Joked "almost died lol", said "lungs on fire, legs fine". Mentioned their roommate laughed when they came back red-faced. Casual, a bit more chatty than before; ZOH pointed to Saturday as round two.

Later he replied "rough week" to the check-in about the week ahead. No step recorded today. Tired but open.
